judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a planning artifact (`.lore/dod.md`), an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), and partial updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`. It did not implement any production code at all: none of `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, or `src/config.ts` were touched. Consequently, the new acceptance tests will fail immediately (and won't even compile or pass typecheck due to the missing `history` option on `createServer`). Furthermore, the first acceptance test expects the current empty session created on connection to be excluded from `conversations`, which contradicts the issue's explicit amendment that the connection's own conversation is listed like any other.
